protocol: Fixed before reading the investigator's output. Investigator received only B1-B5 descriptions, not labels, titles, URLs or this file. Context separation is procedural, not a filesystem sandbox.

cases.title: Each Part Matters: Local Patterns Facilitate Cross-view Geo-localization
cases.mechanism: Concentric square-ring partitioning and per-part feature learning for cross-view localization.

cases.title: Sample4Geo: Hard Negative Sampling For Cross-View Geo-Localisation
cases.mechanism: Geographic and feature-similarity hard-negative sampling for contrastive cross-view representation learning.

cases.title: University-1652: A Multi-view Multi-source Benchmark for Drone-based Geo-localization
cases.mechanism: University-building satellite/drone/ground benchmark and bidirectional drone-satellite retrieval tasks.

cases.title: TransGeo: Transformer Is All You Need for Cross-view Image Geo-localization
cases.mechanism: Transformer cross-view localization without polar transformation and attention-guided non-uniform cropping.

cases.title: RoMa: Robust Dense Feature Matching
cases.mechanism: Frozen foundation features, coarse anchor-based matching and fine refinement.

scoring: Count a substantive already-established or partially-overlapping determination only if a verified matching expected reference and mechanism comparison are present. Uncertain is not a detection. Manual source verification is recorded separately; identifiers alone do not prove overlap.
ground_truth_corrections: Before seeing investigator output, direct source checks invalidated provisional arXiv identifiers 2107.14068 and 2303.11845: these belong to unrelated astronomy and mathematics papers. Removed and replaced with OpenAlex-verified exact DOI/title pairs.
A further attempted LPN locator 2011.14506 was also unrelated and was never accepted as evidence. These errors are a concrete demonstration of why model-memory citations cannot be trusted.
One OpenAlex query returned HTTP 429; the already-recorded successful Sample4Geo retrieval supplied the verified DOI. No label or mechanism expectation changed.
limitations: Five purposively chosen positive overlap cases are a smoke test, not a statistical accuracy estimate.
All cases are overlap positives; this test alone cannot measure specificity or false rejection rate.
The investigator may know these methods from training. Procedural blinding does not establish memorization-free retrieval ability.
